# fswitcher: cmd+tab for multiple displays, grouped by screen
## Channel: forma labs
0 likes

### Description
4 views
Posted: 2026-11-04
fswitcher.app

fswitcher is a cmd+tab replacement for Mac built for multiple displays. It intentionally keeps the same cmd+tab behavior, looks and feels like the native switcher, and allows you to show either app or window tiles.

The switcher appears on each display, and switching only affects the screen you choose. Windowless apps move to the bottom row for less clutter, which you can access with the control key. Hidden apps show dimmed, and minimized apps move out of the way. The same shortcuts that work on the native switcher also work on fswitcher.

### Live previews

fswitcher shows a live thumbnail of each of the selected app's windows, or a full-screen preview right where the window sits, so you know exactly where you'll land before you let go. With several windows open, Command-` or Command and a number slides from one to the next.

 

### Switch by an app's first letter

Turn on Instant Switching and a quick right Command and S goes straight to Safari, with no switcher at all. Hold right Command instead and the switcher shows only the apps starting with that letter. Tap the letter again to step through their windows, and let go to switch.

 

### Less clutter [...] Your options, by what you're after

 Command-Tab as you know it, with a switcher for each display and your windows grouped by desktop and full-screen app: fswitcher (our app).
 An open-source window switcher with thumbnails: AltTab.
 An app switcher where you pick apps by number: Command-Tab Plus.
 Finding windows by typing: Contexts.
 Keeping Witch with different settings: staying with Witch.

# Witch app switcher alternatives for Mac

People look for a Witch alternative for different reasons. Some use more than one display and want each one to have its own switcher. Some keep lots of desktops and full-screen apps and want to see where every window is at a glance. Some want Command-Tab to look and feel like the one built into macOS, just with their windows in it. And some simply want to know what else is out there before they settle on one.

This page goes through your options, what carries over if you're used to Witch, and how the alternatives differ. We make fswitcher, one of those options.
